query_role_note: Synthetic audit query <compact topic> problem passed to existing classifier; no actual topic-conditioned HN search executed. These are conditional evaluations of preselected source records, NOT matched-search precision.
pipeline: frozen existing content guards + exact existing min_relevance_tokens topic gate, without changing classification logic
limitations: September source data are development feedback and not unseen independent holdout.
This probes the topic-conditioned content gate using source contexts, not an actual search query; reported valid_signal is not an observed commercial opportunity.
The same retrieved comment can qualify for multiple topics: topic-record counts cannot be summed as independent buyers.
No blind human review was conducted, so verified false-positive/negative rates are unknown.
The frozen topics were originally specified in the August matched baseline experiment; no post-hoc topic tailoring.
The public HN index may change over time; do not compare raw counts between distinct retrievals as paired tests.
